text:
ana: starting the change window for keystone: rolling from 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0. kicking off canary at 15% now. pls watch eu-west p95 & 5xx dashboards.

deploy-bot: traffic shift initiated -> canary group 'keystone-canary' @ 15%. rollout id: r-1733334444. health checks enabled.

jamie: seeing p95 in eu-west jump to ~1.8s on the observability dashboard (baseline ~0.6s). small 5xx bump (0.15% -> 0.7%). link: https://obs.internal/keystone/eu-west/p95

mike: copying logs from one of the canary pods:
```
kubectl -n prod logs keystone-canary-5f8b | tail -n 80
WARN auth: token refresh latency=480ms
ERROR handler: downstream timeout after 1.2s
```

sara: hmm that downstream timeout looks like a dependency slowness. any recent infra changes in eu-west? network, redis, or rate-limiter configs?

leo: nothing flagged in infra change log. redis metrics look ok. there is a slight CPU tail on keystone-canary replicas.

obs-bot: ALERT: keystone-eu-west p95 > 1.0s for 10m (current 1.8s). Severity: medium. Pager: on-call.

ana: pause the rollout, please. I want a short investigation before pushing further. jamie can you capture flamegraphs from canary? mike, can you check dependency traces?

deploy-bot: rollout r-1733334444 -> PAUSED by ana. traffic pinned at 15% to canary. no further shifts.

jamie: grabbing flamegraphs, running trace capture now. patching temporary increased logging on canary.

mike: dependency traces show latency spikes to payments service during same window, ops team just acknowledged a transient queue backlog at 03:12 UTC.

sara: given 5xx is still low but p95 high and a downstream issue exists, my vote: keep paused and pin production routing to 2.1.0 until payments backlog clears. avoid full rollback unless 5xx crosses 1.5%.

ana: agree. action: leave canary at 15% paused, pin current prod at 2.1.0 (no forced rollback), open incident ticket and mark release notes with "paused - investigating downstream dependency". assign owners.

leo: created INC-173333-KEy with description + links to traces and dashboard. assigning to @payments-oncall and @keystone-sre.

jamie: flamegraphs uploaded to https://obs.internal/artifacts/r-1733334444/flame

mike: I'll keep tailing logs and will post any 5xx spike. if 5xx > 1.5% over 5m we do immediate rollback.

ana: rollback threshold noted. sara will coordinate with payments team to clear backlog; jamie to continue traces; leo to update incident; mike to monitor 5xx. set follow-up check in 12 minutes.

sara: adding note to release tracker + tag: paused-keystone-canary-1733334444

deploy-bot: note: automated canary autoscaler disabled while paused.

ana: thanks team. we'll reconvene at +12m. if things look stable by then we can resume gradual ramp, otherwise we revert. :white_check_mark:
